section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single study that evaluated the Brazilian Portuguese translation of the BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents, reporting a one-dimensional factor structure, gender invariance, adequate reliability, and convergent/incremental validity. It notes a negative relationship between body appreciation and BMI (reported qualitatively), uses a convenience sample from three Brazilian cities, and highlights limitations including the non-representative sample and cross-sectional design.
section_summary.evidence_source: This study examined the psychometric properties of a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the  BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents.; a convenience sample of adolescents from three Brazilian cities were recruited; the negative correlations found with social physique anxiety and BMI; we employed a cross-sectional design that prevent from suggesting a causal direction.
